verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੨ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਪਰਮਾਰਥ ਦਾ ਭੇਦ ਜਰਦੇ ਹਨ
verses.translit_en: pauRee 2 : gurmukh paramaarath dhaa bhedh jaradhe han

en.bdb: Gurmukhs assimilate the mystery of spiritulism

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕਤੁ ਨੁਕਤੈ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ਮਹਰਮੁ ਮੁਜਰਮੁ ਖੈਰ ਖੁਆਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: eikat nukatai hoi jai maharam mujaram khair khuaaree|

en.bdb: In Persian language only a point makes ‘mahram’ the confidant, a mujarim, the offender.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਸਤਾਨੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਸਲਤੀ ਗੈਰ ਮਹਲਿ ਜਾਣਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: masataanee vich masalatee gair mahal jaanaa man maaree|

en.bdb: Gurmukhs remain exhilarated in the holy congregation and they do not like to go to other assemblies.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਲ ਨ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬੰਦੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: gal na baahar nikalai hukamee ba(n)dhe kaar karaaree|

en.bdb: In the will of the Lord they serve vigorously and try not to make it public.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਵਡੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal piram ras dheh bidheh vadde veechaaree|

en.bdb: Such gurmukhs attain the fruit of happiness and giving up the pride of body, and becoming bodiless they become serious thinkers.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਆਸਣੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: gur moorat gur sabadh sun saadhasa(n)gat aasan nira(n)kaaree|

en.bdb: The word of the Guru is their idol and the holy congregation is the seat of the formless Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਆਹਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: aadh purakh aadhes kar a(n)mrit velaa sabadh aahaaree|

en.bdb: Bowing before the primeval Purusa, in the ambrosial hours they chew the Word (gurbani).

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਵਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਅਸਗਾਹ ਅਪਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: avigat gat agaadh bodh akath kathaa asagaeh apaaree|

en.bdb: To have knowledge of the dynamism of that unmanifest Lord is a very deep experience, and to say something of that ineffable Lord is a Herculean task.
Only Gurmukhs suffer while doing good to others.
